claude.reason: The burst bar itself is the decisive problem: a close-to-close gain of -0.04% means the stock closed below its prior close, and the chart confirms the last bar is a down day closing near $245.68 against a prior close of $245.77 — this is not a burst out of the base but a continuation of the sideways chop inside it. RE fails outright (bar range only 76% of the prior 5-bar max), confirming there is no range expansion driving the move. The base itself looks acceptable on the chart — 9 sessions, relatively tight — but without a genuine upward burst bar there is no actionable setup today.
claude.key_risk: The 'burst' is a down close with no price expansion; the stock is still inside the consolidation box with no directional commitment, and the prior breakout in this move has a 0/1 success record.
claude.entry_note: Skip entirely unless tomorrow produces a genuine up close above the base high (~$257) with real range expansion; an open anywhere inside the current box with no follow-through confirms there is no setup.
